title: LBI Color Palette
headline: Transforming light into a medium of precision and possibility...
intro: LBI Color Palette is a RemPhos spectral lighting family offering precision wavelength selection and limitless RGB color mixing through RemPhos technology.
callouts: LBI Color Palette — linkable light bar w/ an internal driver delivering precision wavelength selection
LBI Color Palette+ — linkable light bar w/ an internal driver delivering limitless RGB color mixing
Stay tuned... DMX is stepping up to the light bar. More control. More possibilities.
Designed for applications where color accuracy matters most
Endless creativity...from subtle accents to dramatic effects
Select color via remote or switch on bar
LBI 65 Palette is also offered for IP65-rated and NSF-certified applications

extras.title: LBI Color PaletteX with DMX
extras.text: DMX is stepping up to the light bar. More control. More possibilities.

extras.title: RGBWW remote
extras.text: The optional RP-REMOTE-RGB-WC remote (holster included) adjusts every LBI Color Palette+ bar in range: white presets, full RGB color, dimming and scenes. Try it in the LBI Family Overview.

extras.title: LBI Color Palette+ default mode and on-bar switches
extras.text: LBI Color Palette+ ships in white light mode and carries G2-style on-bar switches (FlexWatt wattage and FlexColor CCT, as on the standard RP-LBI-G2 bar). Color is selected with the optional RP-REMOTE-RGB-WC remote; one remote adjusts every bar in range.

extras.title: Lighting controls
